issues.title: [BUG]: the whole admin router fails to load — adminController never defines the getQueueStatus it mounts
[BUG]: generateCustomQuiz 500s on every request — a pasted example references three undefined variables
[BUG]: the matchmaker merge deleted its conflict markers instead of resolving them — four files carry both sides
[BUG]: flashcardController.js does not parse — a pasted snippet redeclares quality inside reviewFlashcard
`--base-url` is accepted, documented and cache-keyed, then dropped on the floor for Groq, Anthropic and Google
One malformed entry throws away the entire summary cache, so a whole repository is re-summarized and re-billed
Console output is parsed as Rich markup, so `[slug].tsx` is shown as `.tsx` and a provider error containing a closing tag ends the run
fix(sse): the stream registry leaks the connections it exists to clean up — unbounded, unreaped, and unregister is skippable
fix(api): the two webhook routes share a rate-limit bucket and print unmasked third-party payloads to stdout
[BUG]: models/index.js does not parse — a placeholder registry was merged over the real one
[Feature]: Year-end progression decisions with computed evidence and countersigned overrides
[Feature]: Per-channel publication consent with a usage register and a takedown queue on withdrawal
[Feature]: Attendance register amendments with a guarded single application and monthly certification
[Feature]: Fee concession register with frozen rates, a stacking ceiling and derived net payable
[Feature]: Cover availability profiles with working patterns, dated exclusions and a load ceiling
fix(security): withWebhookGuard admits forged signatures when the secret is unset, and verifyWebhookRequest destroys the body it verified
Tone analyzer calls well-written resumes "Passive" because bullets don't start with "I"; market value estimator renders AWS as "Aws"
[Accessibility]: Five blocking alert() and confirm() dialogs remain — they freeze the tab mid-navigation and are not announced to assistive technology
Proficiency and project scorers ignore evidence the user did provide, then warn them for not providing it
fix(security): the inbound webhook verifier rejects the signatures SecureFlow's own outbound dispatcher sends
